yamlCheck.dateAnchor: Early October is spoken, but no numbered civil date or year is independently stated. Absolute dates use the YAML start of 1748-10-06 conditionally.
yamlCheck.explanation: Current play runs from an evening camp meeting through the next day at the village, one further overnight to dawn at Dark Fire, and the immediate escape. These two explicit night-to-morning transitions support an ending on October 8 conditional on the YAML start, rather than the recorded October 9. Historical visions and background captivity add no adventure days; the final instruction explicitly withholds a long rest. No missing day is supplied from drEnd.
